prompt:
## Objective
Bring the claude adapter to parity with its codex/pi siblings: the CLI must drain output emitted at process exit (currently dropped on :exit_status), and the stream parser must emit cache tokens and cost in usage (currently dropped, so claude runs undercount spend on the dashboard).

## Design summary
Decisions are already made - this is a pattern port, not a design task. Copy the exit-drain pattern from lib/rondo/codex/cli.ex:107,118 and lib/rondo/pi/cli.ex:106,116 into lib/rondo/claude/cli.ex (defect at :116-125). Copy the cache-token/cost parsing shape from codex/stream_parser.ex:133-153 and pi/stream_parser.ex:162-205 into claude/stream_parser.ex (defect at :49-61). Match the siblings' emitted usage fields exactly so downstream spend accounting is uniform.

## File scope
Include: elixir/lib/rondo/claude/cli.ex, elixir/lib/rondo/claude/stream_parser.ex, new/updated tests under elixir/test/.
Exclude: everything else. The codex/pi adapter files are read-only reference implementations - do NOT edit them.

## Constraints
Deny rationale: editing codex/pi siblings risks the exact sibling-drift disease this fix treats; no shared abstraction extraction (that is ticket RON-141); no git push or PR creation - deliver a local branch/diff only. Environment: mix resolves via mise shims; if mix is not found, prepend $HOME/.local/share/mise/shims to PATH. Work test-first: write the failing tests (output-at-exit dropped; cache tokens/cost absent) before porting the patterns. If any acceptance criterion is ambiguous, pause and ask - do not invent behavior.

## Verification
All from the repo root:
1. cd elixir && mix test  (must include the new drain and cache-token tests, all green)
2. cd elixir && mix format --check-formatted
3. cd elixir && mix credo --strict
Known flaky: OrchestratorStatusTest (RON-31, two order-sensitive tests) - verify with a fixed seed against main before treating a failure as real.
dependencies: Reference implementations present at pinned base: codex/cli.ex, pi/cli.ex, codex/stream_parser.ex, pi/stream_parser.ex (probed in authoring session)

success_criteria: cd elixir && mix test exits 0 including new drain + cache-token tests
